// A spatial force: a force in newtons acting at a reference point, plus a
// torque in newton-meters about each axis. Known as a wrench in screw theory.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque)
type SpatialForce3D
    implements IValue, IInterpolatable
{
    Force: Vector3D;
    Torque: Vector3D;
}
